not_established: That the delivered bytes are bound to the payment. This package holds the paid 200's body, artefacts/paid-receipt.json: our own signed market-state receipt, issued at 2026-09-07T16:37:32.817Z for XNYS, CLOSED, signed under key_2026_v1. It carries NO settlement member: no transaction hash, no payer, no nonce, no reference to the payment at all. A holder of this package can verify that the money moved and that a receipt was issued, and cannot show from signatures alone that the one was issued for the other; the ties are circumstantial: the same folder, about two seconds apart (the receipt's issued_at 2026-09-07T16:37:32.817Z, block 51004854's own timestamp 2026-09-07T16:37:35Z, 2.183 s), and the same exchange code, XNYS, in the URL that was paid for (https://headlessoracle.com/v5/status?mic=XNYS) and in the receipt's mic member. No signature covers both. This is a finding against our own work, tracked as B-81, and it is open.

What was bought. The single EIP-3009 signature covers six values and the resource is not among them; the 402 object, the payload's resource and accepted members and the settle answer are unsigned text beside it. That is limit_resource_binding: unsigned on this VALID result, and resource_binding in its coverage block.

Who the submitter is. 0xe74817f4cdc15844314812b2271276e64e890fae is recorded because the chain records it; nothing here says who operates that address, and no facilitator signer list was supplied. That is limit_facilitator_identity: unsigned_list.

That the chain answers are the chain's. Two independently operated endpoints were read and agreed and the block is at height, which is two parties rather than one, not zero. That is limit_rpc_trust: verifier_choice.
That this record has been independently re-run. It has not; status_label is unverified, and the assessor operates the payer account, the resource server and the verifier.

That the shared directory and the instants are the only tie. The record this one supersedes said so, and said the instants were three seconds apart; the bytes in this package show a second circumstantial tie, the exchange code XNYS in the paid URL and in the receipt, and an interval of 2.183 s, about two seconds. Neither tie is a signature. The statement.md inside packages/x402-base-2026-09-07-0x94bfba79/ carries the superseded wording at its lines 53 to 54, and RELEASE-NOTES.md carries it at its lines 144 to 145; that package is covered by SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sig and is not edited, so this record is where the correction lives.

Which build of the worker signed this receipt, and so whether the cause named here is the cause. The cited heartbeat postdates issued_at, and the worker's source at headless-oracle-v5 commit 7a0bafe (2026-09-07T15:29:07Z) shows how: src/index.ts:11005 takes `now` once when the request arrives; the unkeyed paid path awaits the facilitator's verify and settle (11448, which reaches /settle at 3170) before the receipt is built; buildSignedReceipt writes that arrival `now` as issued_at (9699) and passes it to buildReceiptCoverage, which reads the halt monitor's heartbeat at that later moment (1577) and copies its ran_at, stamped by the monitor's own clock (10645, 10813), into feed_last_run (1581); and the test at 1582 to 1588 marks a heartbeat stale only when it is more than 180 s old, so one dated after `now` reads live. So issued_at is the request's arrival time, not the signing time. 7a0bafe is the newest commit before Cloudflare version fa5c5cfb-cb2d-4252-8463-511b32d1b744 was created at 2026-09-07T15:59:26.886Z, the version recorded as live when this receipt was taken; the deploy record names a version, not a commit, so that this version was built from 7a0bafe's tree is not established, and neither is whether the 0.839 s is this ordering, a clock difference between isolates, or both. The one-sided freshness test is unchanged at headless-oracle-v5 3f58128 and is tracked as B-120.
establishes: That 0x13bf013EDb5c8bbA2747b06031bcDbb6C5173F63 signed an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for 1000 atomic units of USDC on Base to 0x26D4Ffe98017D2f160E2dAaE9d119e3d8b860AD3, that the signature recovers that address under the EIP-712 domain the 402 object's own members name, and that those terms are the terms the server published.

That the settle answer names the same payer, the same network and transaction 0x94bfba79903d560e54bf0bf79c347d54d057357fb3389ab9dfd76e44d0bdbdd1, and that the transaction succeeded on Base at block 51004854, whose own timestamp is 1788799055 = 2026-09-07T16:37:35Z.

That the block carries exactly one USDC Transfer from the payer to the payee for exactly 1000 atomic units and an AuthorizationUsed naming the same authorizer and nonce, so the transfer is that authorization being consumed, and that the block at that height carries the block hash the receipt claims.
That a paid response was delivered and is carried here, and that it names no settlement. That absence is itself the finding: it is established by the bytes, not inferred from their lack.
That the verifier's own output for these bytes is VALID / verified, exit code 0, stopped_at null and no checks left unevaluated.

That the signed coverage string in artefacts/paid-receipt.json carries feed_last_run 2026-09-07T16:37:33.656Z, 0.839 s later than the receipt's own issued_at 2026-09-07T16:37:32.817Z, while feed_state is live: the receipt cites a halt-monitor heartbeat dated after the instant it states it was issued. This is a finding against our own receipt.
